method_log.selection_rule: min condition_number among PSD estimators (estimation-quality only, no return/SR reference)

covariance_structure.form: Sigma = B Omega B' + D (market single-factor + idiosyncratic; annualized x252)
covariance_structure.note: all three estimators well-conditioned (cond<70 << 500 floor); LW chosen for max stability + finite-sample shrinkage. No ill-conditioning, no eigen-floor needed.

factor_specific_share.interpretation: idiosyncratic-dominated cross-section (78.5% specific) — consistent with a settlement-identity flow sleeve whose names are not co-driven by a single common factor; RF-R1 NOT triggered (max single-name market share 36% < 40%).

concentration.note: EW-proxy concentration only; optimizer sets actual weights. Sector well-diversified (n_eff 8.7).

risk_summary.crowding_self_reference_caveat: FLOW is itself a CROWDING-UNWIND/price-pressure-reversal signal (Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005): it buys names being net-SOLD by crowded foreign/institutional flow. Intrinsic crowding of the resulting holdings is structurally LOW (all scores 0.30-0.36 << 0.75 threshold). The relevant crowding risk is META: if many managers adopt the same contrarian-flow signal the reversal premium decays — not capturable from this single-book snapshot; flagged for monitoring decay.
risk_summary.crisis_hedge_verdict: PARTIAL. The alpha-package crisis-strengthening claim (crisis_ic 0.074 vs normal 0.0177, AX-001 v2 ratio 4.18) is a SIGNAL-IC property and is accepted at face value (not re-measured here). At the realized top20-HOLDINGS level the EW sleeve UNDERPERFORMED bm in equity crashes (COVID -40.1% vs -32.9%; GFC/Euro worse-but-UNRELIABLE) yet markedly OUTPERFORMED in the 2022 monetary-tightening drawdown (-11.5% vs bm -23.0%). Interpretation: foreign-flight-reversal hedge manifests in slow flow-driven regimes (2022) rather than fast liquidity crashes (COVID). Sleeve beta 1.16 means it is NOT a low-beta defensive sleeve — diversification benefit is correlation/timing-based, not beta-reduction.

tail_risk.note: mean lower-tail dependence 0.279 just below 0.30 threshold (marginal PASS); max pairwise 0.510 indicates a co-crash cluster (likely chemicals/IT cyclicals). Negative skew -0.37 + excess kurtosis 0.77 = mild left-fat-tail, typical KR equity.

style_exposure.model: EW-top20-sleeve daily return ~ MKT + SMB + MOM (FF-style proxies from RAWDATA; VALUE/RMW/CMA unavailable in RAWDATA -> partial FF5)
style_exposure.orthogonality_assessment: Two levels must be distinguished. (1) SIGNAL-level orthogonality (alpha-package): cor vs STR_1715 -0.070, cor vs D -0.010 — genuinely orthogonal alpha axes (settlement-flow vs earnings-revision vs microstructure). ACCEPTED. (2) HOLDINGS-level style: the realized top20 carries market beta 1.17 and a significant MOMENTUM tilt (t 3.9). STR_1715 (earnings-revision/momentum) ALSO loads momentum, so at the realized-holdings level FLOW and 1715 may share momentum-style exposure even while their alpha signals are uncorrelated. This is a multi-sleeve overlap RISK to flag for the optimizer, NOT an alpha defect.
style_exposure.style_overlap_flag: MOMENTUM style co-loading between FLOW and STR_1715 — recommend optimizer monitor combined momentum active exposure.

regime_correlation.note: intra-sleeve correlation rises +0.07 in 2022 stress era (correlation breakdown is mild, not a co-crash blowup). Window-internal regime split proxy (crisis = 2022+); CRISIS n=450, normal n=63 within trailing window.

red_flag_assessment.RF-R1_top_risk_gt_40pct: PASS (mean market var share 21.5%, max single-name 36%)

ax_compliance.AX-007: multi-sleeve framing — FLOW is 4th sleeve combined with STR_1715+D; single-sleeve top20 metric-break exception (multi-sleeve) applies. Risk diagnostics measure co-movement structure, not standalone graduation.
